chain_head_rule: vN+1 by the {path, sha256} pair; readers resolve the chain head by the <family>_v<N>.json glob and follow the pair; ONE producer's block is added or changed per version, by that producer, with the pair from the head it read; v1 is never edited; IMMUTABLE ONCE LANDED: a landed version file is never modified -- a landing whose diff shows M on an existing version (instead of A on a new one) is a refusal, and a producer versioning the chain re-reads the head AFTER its rebase/copy and before its commit; if the head moved, it re-versions from the new head
